text.zh: 夺冠发布会，一名记者举手：「你觉得自己是世界最佳吗？」
text.en: At the title-winning press conference, a reporter raises a hand: 'Do you think you're the best in the world?'

label.zh: 「我来了，我看见，我征服」——当然，这问题有点蠢
label.en: 'I came, I saw, I conquered' — obviously. Silly question, really.

note.zh: 致敬伊布拉希莫维奇的招牌狂言

background.zh: 伊布的狂言数不胜数，自信到常用第三人称称呼自己，把「凡尔赛」玩成了艺术。
background.en: Ibrahimović's quotes are legendary — so confident he often refers to himself in the third person.

label.zh: 功劳是全队的，我只是做好了本职
label.en: It's the whole team's — I just did my job

label.zh: 让我的奖杯柜替我回答吧
label.en: I'll let my trophy cabinet answer that one
(So nervous you can't get a single word out)
